# Roles and permissions on Cartwheel

Cartwheel has three roles. Shoppers can see and manage their own orders. Merchants can see and manage orders of their own store, and cannot see other stores' orders or shoppers' other purchases. Support staff can look up any order. The platform enforces these permissions in its systems; support assistants cannot grant exceptions.
content.title: Roles and permissions on Cartwheel

trace.text:
Per Cartwheel's roles and permissions policy (cw-roles), here's the picture:

- **Merchants can see and manage orders placed with their own store** — that includes an order's details for their store's products (items, amounts, shipping status, and so on) and managing things like fulfillment or refunds for those orders.
- **What they can't see:** orders placed with other stores, or your purchases from any other store on the platform. A merchant has no visibility into the rest of your shopping history.

The platform enforces these limits in its systems, so there's no way around them — even support assistants can't grant exceptions.
